create_adam_optimizer: create an Adam optimizer instance with custom learning rate, betas, and weight decay parameters
prepare_adam_with_param_groups: prepare the Adam optimizer by passing model parameter groups to initialize torch.optim.Adam
build_adam_from_config: build an Adam optimizer from a configuration dictionary with lr, betas, eps, and amsgrad settings
register_adam_optimizer: register the Adam optimizer class with the ClassyVision optimizer registry using the adam key
review_adam_from_config_validation: review the from_config method that validates betas tuple values are floats in the range [0, 1)
